about: Every place the estate decided what words MEAN by matching them, from the word-matching audit of 23 Sep 2026 (class i: a decision about meaning that must become reasoning). founder_instruction 886-903: 'NO word matching anywhere'. 'migrated' = the meaning now comes from _shared/think.ts and its 'proof' is enforced by scripts/checks/decision_points_are_reasoned.test.mjs. 'pending' = still word-decided, in the order they will be migrated (customer-facing and money first). A regex that guards OUR outgoing text, or parses a format, is not listed: the ruling permits it.

a held WhatsApp/social question reasoned after the hold lifts is delivered on its own channel: WhatsApp free text inside the 24-hour window, the support_reply template outside it; social through the platform reply path
fn_wa_answer: body tokens vs wa_reply_intent.match_patterns pick the deterministic intent (incl. contact_human)
points.held: p_intent is null: fn_wa_answer answers nothing from the intent table and logs the message as held, never matched. Held (the model hold): nothing is guessed. WhatsApp answers from what needs no meaning (the approved FAQ, then the courteous line and the menu, the question filed as a knowledge gap), then files the meaning in customer_support's queue (queueWhatsAppMeaning); the replay sends the reasoned answer on WhatsApp — free text in the 24-hour window, the support_reply template outside it (reasoned_delivery.ts, wa_inbound.intent_table). The replay calls fn_wa_answer with the reasoned intent; a request for a person is delivered by wa_inbound.needs_a_person, never twice.

must_contain: drop function if exists public.fn_wa_answer(text, text);

WhatsApp answers from what needs no meaning (the approved FAQ, then the courteous line and the menu, the question filed as a knowledge gap), then files the meaning in customer_support's queue (queueWhatsAppMeaning); the replay sends the reasoned answer on WhatsApp — free text in the 24-hour window, the support_reply template outside it (reasoned_delivery.ts, wa_inbound.intent_table). The replay builds the list from the live taxonomy_trade rows (coverageReply).

points.held: No trade is claimed while held (the exact-trade rule): no label substring is read. Held (the model hold): nothing is guessed. WhatsApp answers from what needs no meaning (the approved FAQ, then the courteous line and the menu, the question filed as a knowledge gap), then files the meaning in customer_support's queue (queueWhatsAppMeaning); the replay sends the reasoned answer on WhatsApp — free text in the 24-hour window, the support_reply template outside it (reasoned_delivery.ts, wa_inbound.intent_table). The replay answers the reasoned trade:<code> from the live row, or the list and the welcome for a trade we do not list (coverage:other).

points.decides: isSizeQuestion: a canned capability statement pre-empts every other handler
points.held: A size question is not guessed to be one: no surface sends the capability statement on a word. WhatsApp: Held (the model hold): nothing is guessed. WhatsApp answers from what needs no meaning (the approved FAQ, then the courteous line and the menu, the question filed as a knowledge gap), then files the meaning in customer_support's queue (queueWhatsAppMeaning); the replay sends the reasoned answer on WhatsApp — free text in the 24-hour window, the support_reply template outside it (reasoned_delivery.ts, wa_inbound.intent_table). Social: the honest unknown goes and the meaning waits in the marketing queue (replay: the statement on the platform). Widget: nothing is queued (an anonymous visitor cannot be answered later); the widget's own path answers or files a knowledge gap.

points.decides: routeQuestion COST/COUNT/TIMELINE/TRADE_PRICE regexes pick a canned FAQ as the final answer (site widget, social)
points.held: No canned FAQ is chosen on a word. Widget: siteQuestion is held and never queued (no channel to answer an anonymous visitor later); the widget's own path (price guide, corpus, gateway) answers or files the question as a knowledge gap. Social: the honest unknown goes and the meaning (faq:<type>) waits in the marketing queue; the replay sends the FAQ on the platform.

points.decides: matchLibrary: match_words substrings pick a standard public reply
points.held: No standard reply is picked on a word: the honest unknown library reply goes now (the gap recorded, a person offered) and the meaning waits in the marketing seat's queue with the retrieved passages on the row; the replay sends the reasoned library / FAQ / passage reply on the platform, inside Meta's window, once (marketing_social_inbox reasoned_reply). A public comment is never queued; the comment policy owns it.

points.decides: onTopic: a shared word decides a corpus passage answers the question
points.held: No passage is quoted because it shares a word: held, the honest unknown goes and the meaning waits in the marketing queue carrying the exact passages it was reasoned over; the replay quotes the reasoned passage (kb:<n>) on the platform.

points.decides: SUP_RE/CUS_RE audienceFromText: customer vs supplier
points.held: Held, the audience stays unknown (never guessed from phrases); the side is one dimension of the widget's single reasoned decision (widgetMeaning), asked only when neither the session nor the page path says it. The prompt's own rule applies: answer what holds for both sides. Never queued: the visitor is answered now.

menuChoice: a typed menu TITLE matched as words picks the menu branch (exact menu ids / digits stay as format parsing; free text is reasoned) — found by B2
founderCommand: a command grammar read from the founder's free text; stays only if it is exact-token structured commands, otherwise reasoned — found by B2
